author: warren
name: blue-gold-mesh
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Mesh drift style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#FFBF00, #050514, #F3B007, #2600FB). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl), high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
